description: Provisions a new Privy user and an Ethereum embedded wallet that works on Monad mainnet (143) and testnet (10143). Returns the user_id and wallet address. Server requires PRIVY_APP_ID + PRIVY_APP_SECRET to be configured.

email.description: Email to attach as the user's linked account. If omitted, a placeholder is generated.

name: create_user
title: Create a Privy user with a Monad-ready wallet
